observations.contract: Rejected scheduled contact and retained authority
observations.trace: The pending-contact system queues removal of PendingMeleeContact then queues MeleeAttackIntent. Bevy0.19.1 source queues both and applies commands in order. On a targeted completion rejected by the cheap range gate, MeleeCompletion::prepare logs and returns without authorize or complete_miss; the prior windup and active attack remain in the per-entity authority. The untargeted-miss branch separately calls complete_miss.
observations.remaining: No actual queued commands or combat ran. The finding applies only when the selected completion is rejected and no other state transition clears/overwrites authority; all observer, scheduling and lifecycle alternatives remain open.

observations.trace: Suppose A starts at tick0, B starts at tick8, B target is A and B contact at tick24 is rejected out of range, B attack remains in recovery through tick40, and A contacts B at tick32 after coming in range. At64Hz, B starts0.125 seconds after A, within the authored0.5-second reflex window. With no pending dodge, a blocking weapon and no shield, the selected reciprocal path still finds B active/windup, computes ready_at.elapsed_since(now)=0 via saturating subtraction, and the core committed-threat selector chooses FinishTrade. The scheduled B contact was already removed and its completion rejected.
observations.remaining: This is a hypothetical source-level timeline, not an observed actor, move, authority state, random draw, combat result or runtime test. Actual feasible authored weapon timings, ECS scheduling, movement and intended recovery/defense policy need qualification. Do not infer a globally reachable player incident or mandate a particular defense fallback.

observations.trace: Initial melee selection and later unforced completion both use the retained contact_sample. The selected core targeting function chooses body part solely from weighted_body_part_and_local(sample, constant factor); gap targeting shifts the local surface coordinate afterward. Changing precision can alter the surface coordinate but not that body-part selection for the same admitted sample.
observations.remaining: This is a scoped counterexample to a suspected selected-body mismatch, not a full stance, armor, timing or numeric verdict. No targeting function ran.

observations.contract: Config owner and ranged event scope
observations.trace: The lunge helper ignores its passed config, but core melee_lunge reads the process runtime melee snapshot. Selected startup validates and installs that snapshot before retaining the same config in the Bevy app. Ranged publication uses the common ApplyMeleeAttackResult and MeleeAttackResolved path with intended zero melee contact timing. Its selected iteration logger has a melee-shaped record; stock iteration spawn_weapon sets ranged=false.
observations.remaining: Later public snapshot installs or resource mutation may diverge but no supported drift was established. A different ranged event producer could reach a consumer that interprets the melee-shaped fields, yet no stock melee iteration ranged event or report ran. Both policy questions remain open.

conditional_findings.kind: conditional current action-lifecycle and defense decision
conditional_findings.qualification: A rejected targeted scheduled melee completion leaves active authority after pending removal; under the recorded later reciprocal-defense conditions it can be treated as a trade although that contact will not occur. No product event or supported timing witness was observed.
